title: Wgpu Renderer Note Canvas Parity
description: Implement the note-canvas componentScene surface in the wgpu renderer (framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs), which currently falls through to a placeholder. Port geometry/interaction logic from framework/renderer/react/components/note-canvas-host.tsx (block bounds/hit-testing, resize handles, screen<->world conversion, ink erasers, snap-to-grid, marquee selection) into a direct DrawList painter (render_note_canvas) following the render_canvas_2d/render_raster pattern, wired into SceneSurfaceState pointer handling. Verify against the `note` playground comparing wgpu vs react renderers.
summary:
Implemented the note-canvas componentScene surface for the wgpu renderer, porting geometry/interaction logic from note-canvas-host.tsx (React reference) into a direct DrawList painter following the render_canvas_2d/render_raster pattern.

Delivered:
- render_note_canvas: paints grid, all block kinds (text/image/table/math/ink/group placeholder), selection/hover rings, 8-direction resize handles, and marquee selection, all using note-canvas's own top-left-relative screen<->world camera convention (verified to differ from the shared centered Viewport used by canvas2d/raster).
- Full geometry helper suite mirroring the TSX pure functions (block bounds/hit-testing including ink point-bounds, resize-bounds math, group-scale-on-resize, ink point/stroke erasers with fragment-splitting, snap-to-grid), operating on serde_json::Value to avoid duplicating the note plugin's large tagged-enum block schema.
- Pointer interaction (note_pointer_down/up/hover_move/wheel) wired into SurfaceKind::NoteCanvas arms of handle_scene_pointer_button/handle_scene_pointer_move/handle_scene_wheel, with new SceneDragMode variants (NotePan/NoteMove/NoteResize/NoteInk/NoteEraser/NoteMarqueeDrag) and SceneSurfaceState fields (note_camera, note_overrides, note_marquee_points) for live-drag optimistic rendering. Faithfully replicates the plugin's begin/live/commit/atomic gesture-phase protocol for applyNoteEvents (move/resize use live+commit only, matching React's exact call pattern; ink/eraser use begin+live+commit).
- 8 unit tests in a new note_canvas_tests module covering hit-testing, resize-handle geometry, screen<->world roundtrips, snap, and ink bounds — all passing.

Verified: cargo check and cargo test -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu both pass cleanly (confirmed on multiple runs). Visually confirmed in the browser via the `note` playground (dev:note, SEMIO_RENDERER=wgpu) that the grid renders correctly and the full note toolbar/window chrome works with no panics.

Known gaps, scoped out deliberately:
- Inline text/table-cell editing (contentEditable rich text) has no equivalent primitive in this native renderer and was not implemented; blocks can be placed/selected/moved/resized but not text-edited from the canvas.
- Double-click-to-create-text-block was skipped since it's low-value without inline editing.
- IMPORTANT DISCOVERY: interactive pointer testing (click to place a block, drag to move, etc.) could not be confirmed end-to-end in the browser, and root-caused this to a pre-existing, repo-wide gap: handle_scene_pointer_button/handle_scene_pointer_move (the generic scene-interaction functions used by Canvas2d, Raster, NodeGraph, TextEditor, and now NoteCanvas) are fully implemented but never called from the real input loop anywhere in the codebase — confirmed via repo-wide grep. Only GisMap has its own bespoke, correctly-wired pointer functions (gis_map_pointer_down/move/up called from ShellState::handle_pointer_button/handle_pointer_move). This affects multiple surfaces, not just note-canvas, so I did not fix it in this ticket; flagged a follow-up task instead (spawned as task_53aa85c4) rather than risk destabilizing other surfaces' already-shipped interactions via a large shared-file change under heavy concurrent editing.
- Browser verification was also significantly hampered by sustained build/dev-server instability from concurrent developers editing this same massive shared lib.rs file throughout the session (repeated transient wasm-bindgen filesystem races, server process deaths, and finally an unrelated in-progress refactor removing CommandDescriptor from framework/core/rs/lib.rs that broke the whole workspace build).

Registered a `note-wgpu-dev` entry in .claude/launch.json (port 6180, SEMIO_RENDERER=wgpu) alongside the existing note-react-dev, for future comparison testing.
